title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. In the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at (0.017, 0.017) with a radius of 0.017. For the second loop, draw another circle with the same center point but a smaller radius of 0.0125. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.0341. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it with the same vector. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to form a solid body. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object will be 0.03409090909090909 units in length, 0.03409090909090909 units in width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.017, 0.017)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.017)         # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0125)        # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Create a tube (hollow cylinder) along the Z axis
outer_diameter = 0.0340
inner_diameter = 0.0260
height = 0.7500

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(outer_diameter / 2.0)
    .circle(inner_diameter / 2.0)
    .extrude(height)
)
